title: Frontend Development — Beginner
description: Learn the foundations of the web: HTML structure, CSS styling and layout, and core JavaScript.

sections.title: HTML Foundations
sections.description: Learn to structure web content using semantic HTML elements.
learning_objectives: Use forms, lists, and tables correctly

sections.title: CSS Foundations & Responsive Design
sections.description: Style web pages and build layouts that adapt to different screen sizes.
learning_objectives: Build layouts with Flexbox and Grid
Use media queries for responsive design

sections.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
sections.description: Learn core JavaScript syntax, data types, and control flow.
learning_objectives: Use variables, functions, and control structures
Understand scope and basic ES6+ syntax

sections.title: The DOM & Browser APIs
sections.description: Manipulate web pages dynamically using the DOM and browser APIs.

sections.title: Working with HTTP & APIs
sections.description: Understand how browsers communicate with servers and how to consume data.

sections.title: Accessibility Basics
sections.description: Build web pages that are usable by people with disabilities.

title: Frontend Development — Intermediate
description: Build interactive, component-based applications using React.

sections.title: React Fundamentals
sections.description: Learn the core concepts of building UIs with React components.

sections.title: React State & Hooks
sections.description: Manage component state and side effects using React hooks.

sections.title: Consuming APIs in React
sections.description: Fetch and manage remote data inside React applications.

sections.title: Frontend Testing Basics
sections.description: Write tests for components and user interactions.

sections.title: State Management Patterns
sections.description: Apply patterns for managing state across larger applications.
learning_objectives: Recognize when a state library is warranted

title: Frontend Development — Advanced
description: Architect, optimize, and harden production frontend applications.

sections.title: Frontend Architecture at Scale
sections.description: Structure large frontend codebases for maintainability.

sections.title: Performance Optimization
sections.description: Diagnose and fix performance bottlenecks in web applications.

sections.title: Advanced Accessibility
sections.description: Apply advanced accessibility patterns and auditing techniques.

sections.title: Advanced Testing Strategies
sections.description: Apply end-to-end and integration testing strategies at scale.
learning_objectives: Design a testing pyramid for a frontend app

sections.title: Production Frontend Concerns
sections.description: Address the realities of shipping and operating frontend apps in production.
learning_objectives: Plan safe rollouts of UI changes

sections.title: Advanced React Patterns
sections.description: Apply advanced component and hook patterns for complex UIs.
learning_objectives: Apply render patterns for flexible components
